query:
WITH RECURSIVE down(item_id, n) AS (
                        SELECT $1::uuid, 1
                    UNION ALL
                        SELECT l.from_item_id, down.n + 1
                          FROM down
                          JOIN item_link l ON l.to_item_id = down.item_id
                         WHERE l.kind = 'parent' AND l.deleted_at IS NULL AND down.n < $2
                )
                SELECT MAX(n) AS "levels!" FROM down
